title: SG-4.2.2 · Untrack the tracked node_modules files in game/frontend
summary: Untrack about 15,000 tracked node_modules files without deleting them from disk, and guard against any being tracked
description: Context: about 15,329 files under game/frontend/node_modules (Phaser, its type-generation tests, .vite/vitest/results.json) are still in the git index although .gitignore already holds node_modules/. Desired behavior: a code-level cleanup untracks them with git rm --cached, and a unit test with mocked file listings fails while any dependency path is tracked. Why: vendored Phaser changes must never appear as tracked changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mocked tracked-file listing containing node_modules paths, when the guard runs, then it fails naming those paths
Given a listing with no node_modules paths, when the guard runs, then it passes
Given the cleanup runs, then it uses git rm --cached only and removes nothing from disk

in_scope: Helper, cleanup and guard in game/frontend/src/lib
Unit tests with a mocked git runner
out_of_scope: Running git against the real repo in tests

technical_constraints: Vitest with jsdom in game/frontend; tests live in game/frontend/tests
Git invoked only through an injected runner
definition_of_done: All three requirements are implemented and verified
